outcome: patterns of gestational age at presentation
cohort: A total of 2688 women attending the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Nobel Medical College and Teaching Hospital were studied.
finding: The prevalence of teenage pregnancy was 5.3%, with the majority (66.4%) of adolescents presenting at 37 to 40 weeks gestational age, and only 1.4% of teenage mothers having used injectable contraception.
